title: Coast Guard Rescue
description: B-roll of the Coast Guard airlifting someone from a body of water

transcript.text: We arrived on scene early about 10 miles away or so.
We started to immediately locate the four people in the water.
We were splashing the water and waving their hands and waving their floatation devices.
After about a 50 foot hover so we decided the best thing to do is load the Rusty Swimmer
because I would see him for Rusty Swimmer.
We backed off and then tried to evaluate what to do from there.
Our Rusty Swimmer basket down to him so we started loading the basket and just hoisted three of the victims on board our helicopter.
The fourth people come look for ya.
You know, stay in the groups, don't separate and try to make yourself as big as possible by standing group.
Or even like they did, they just started splashing and waving their hands to make it easier for a rescuer to see them.
